node.title: Rank-eleven heavy-plane Segre shortening and transversality
node.closure: the heavy rank-four plane becomes a locator-free field-internal Segre split pencil with many used factors and a low-exception direction record
node.statement: The heavy rank-four residual plane of mass at least 9965407986 has a full common locator of degree 37733 through 1048569. Cancelling it reversibly gives a shortened row of dimension 4 through 1010840 and a base-free 2 x 2 product space for which P tensor Q maps isomorphically onto the four-dimensional correction space. Evaluation columns are field-internal Segre points and associated containers are ruling planes gQ. The rank-two cap forces at least 41 used projective factors, and the exact support-local envelope uniformly forces a direction record with at most 11 exceptions. Base-field normalization and aggregate payment remain open.
